where: Duskapple Orchard — Tinderwick's old orchard through the west hedge (the satchel errand, the fallen-star crater)
mood: First light on the water — the hometown tune's rising half asked under orchard boughs, Lydian wonder with a thread of mystery.
core_styles: C Lydian, bright major with a raised fourth for wonder
soft pulse-wave lead with a rising questioning melody
bright bell and celesta sparkle figures climbing upward like lantern windows
dreamy wandering orchard at blue hour, curious and wondering, a little mysterious

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a curious opening: bell sparkles climb upward like fireflies, then the lead calls the rising three-note lift from the hometown tune and holds it, a question in the air, leading into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the orchard melody: a hummable rising phrase with the bright raised fourth, answered by a bell echo each time, harp rolling underneath at a gentle walk}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody again with a celesta counter-line glinting between phrases and a soft shaker walk, a little fuller}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a hushed turn to A minor, the lead lower and slower, a faint mysterious shimmer like something fallen glowing among the trees, then the bells climb back toward the light}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the orchard melody returns bright and full; the last bar climbs straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
